Dear Mr. Zeeshan,

With reference to your comments communicated through Mr. Jazzy, we confirm that a meeting was held with Abu Ziyad wherein a request was formally presented for a grace period of up to fifteen (15) days for completion of the payment transfer. In addition, upon Mr. Jazzy’s personal request, Abu Ziyad has agreed to extend a price concession in the amount of SAR 30,000, which has been duly acknowledged and accepted.

Please find attached the draft Sale Agreement for your review and consideration. You are kindly requested to examine the same and provide any comments, revisions, or reservations at your earliest convenience. Upon execution of the Agreement, we shall furnish all relevant warranties and structural documentation in line with the requirements outlined by your civil engineer.
We further draw your attention to the condition set by Abu Ziyad that a deposit is required by tomorrow in order to secure and reserve the property. Accordingly upon your acceptance and signing of the Sale Agreement we request you to proceed with the initial deposit without delay to avoid any risk of the property being released.

We would like to seek your professional guidance regarding the establishment of a Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) company in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia for a real estate investment structure.
Our intended structure is as follows:
One SPV company will be established to own a single residential building.
Eight (8) individual investors will participate as shareholders in the SPV.
Each investor will hold shares proportionate to their ownership stake in the property.
In this regard, we kindly request your advice on the following:
The complete legal procedure for establishing an SPV in Saudi Arabia under the above structure.
The regulatory requirements and approvals involved (including any requirements from relevant authorities such as the Ministry of Commerce or other governing bodies).
Whether this structure is compliant with current real estate ownership laws in the Kingdom, particularly in relation to multi-investor ownership under a single entity.
The documentation required from each investor (local and/or foreign investors, if applicable).
The estimated timeline for incorporation and readiness of the SPV.
A detailed breakdown of all associated costs, including:
Company registration fees
Legal and professional fees
Government charges
Any ongoing compliance or annual maintenance costs
Any tax implications or Zakat considerations applicable to the SPV structure.
Your recommendation on the most suitable legal form for such an SPV (e.g., LLC or other structure).
We would appreciate it if you could also advise whether a separate SPV is required per property, or if a single SPV can be structured to accommodate multiple assets in the future.
Kindly share your proposal, including your professional fees and scope of services, at your earliest convenience.
